title: When Kubernetes Works but the Application Still Fails
description: Kubernetes autoscaling can add pods past what PostgreSQL accepts. Treat a connection budget as an architecture decision, and see which tool enforces each part.
og_headline: Every Layer Passed. The System Failed.
og_alt: Every Layer Passed. The System Failed. Kubernetes autoscaling against a PostgreSQL connection budget.

reciprocal.desc: Every layer passes its checks while the service runs out of database connections.
